questions.prompt: How many total individual grains of salt are contained inside a standard one-kilogram cylindrical container of fine table salt?
reasoning: A single fine grain of table salt has an approximate mass of about 0.04 milligrams.
One kilogram equals one million milligrams.
Dividing one million milligrams by 0.04 milligrams gives about 25 million grains per kilogram.

questions.prompt: How many total individual flower petals are plucked or fallen across all public parks in Paris during the peak autumn cleanup month?
reasoning: Paris has approximately 500 hectares of public green spaces and parks.
Each square metre of parkland features numerous flowering plants and trees dropping roughly 100 petals during peak seasonal transitions.
Multiplying the total square metres by the petal density yields around 450 million petals.

questions.prompt: How many total individual drops of water are discharged by a standard kitchen faucet leaking at a rate of one drop every two seconds over the course of a single entire year?
reasoning: A year has 365 days, which equals 525,600 minutes or 31,536,000 seconds.
A leak rate of one drop every two seconds means half a drop falls per second.
Multiplying 31,536,000 seconds by 0.5 drops per second gives 15,768,000 total drops.
